origin.audience: Academic staff, HR administrators, department heads and performance coordinators
origin.cta: Request one task-agreement and evidence snapshot pilot.

units.source_text: Performance review panic starts when evidence was never collected as evidence.

A controlled private proof mapped 190 evidence records to performance objectives, retained review candidates and exposed evidence gaps without making a rating decision.

If Institute of People Management (IPM) is shown 'Fake staff annual-review case: agreement + approved Outlook/file evidence -> KPA/task mapping -> gaps -> human-reviewed performance snapshot.', then the HR/performance-management decision-maker is more likely to request a bounded pilot because the offer addresses a specific workflow pain without surrendering human authority.

Call to action: Request one task-agreement and evidence snapshot pilot.
